question: Which feature in MS-PowerPoint 2019 allows you to reuse slides from another presentation without copying content manually?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reuse Slides (under the Home tab)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Reuse Slides** feature in MS-PowerPoint 2019 allows users to import slides from existing presentations without manually copying or recreating content.
 
• It is located under the **Home tab** in the ribbon menu and can be accessed via the **New Slide** dropdown menu.
 
• This feature enables users to maintain formatting and styles from the original presentation or adapt them to match the current presentation's theme.
 
• Users can browse presentations stored on their local device or connected network to select specific slides for reuse.
 
• The Reuse Slides feature is particularly useful for saving time and ensuring consistency in presentations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Slide Master:**

 
 
• Slide Master is a tool in PowerPoint used to create and maintain consistent formatting across all slides in a presentation.
 
• It allows users to edit fonts, colors, and layouts globally without modifying each slide individually.
 
• This feature is helpful for creating templates and ensuring professional design.
 
 
 
• **Format Painter:**
 
 
• Format Painter allows users to copy formatting (e.g., text style, color, and size) from one object and apply it to another.
 
• It is located under the Home tab and simplifies repetitive formatting tasks.
 
 
 
• **Animation Painter:**
 
 
• Animation Painter helps replicate animation effects from one object to another within the presentation.
 
• It is located under the Animations tab in PowerPoint.
 
 
 
• **Presentation Templates:**
 
 
• PowerPoint provides pre-designed templates that help users create visually appealing presentations quickly.
 
• Templates include preset layouts, color schemes, and font styles.
